name: Amazon Route 53 / MyEtherWallet hijack
notes: AS10297 (eNet) announced /24 more-specifics of Amazon's Route 53 prefixes (covered by AS16509's /23s 205.251.192-198). The hijack redirected DNS resolutions for myetherwallet.com and other Route 53-served domains to attacker-controlled servers, ultimately stealing ~$152k in cryptocurrency. onset_iso is the first AS10297 announcement at RRC00 in the data fetched on 2026-05-10 (peer 6881, path '6881 15685 6939 10297', prefix 205.251.192.0/24, 11:05:50Z). Five distinct /24s observed announced by AS10297 during the captured 30-minute window: 205.251.192.0/24, 193.0/24, 195.0/24, 197.0/24, 199.0/24 -- matches Cloudflare's reported set. The incident continued for ~2 hours total; this fixture covers the onset.
